transcript: A large social experiment revealed something about human nature. Someone would lose a wallet, and a stranger would find it. The experiment was to assess whether the wallet was returned The result was astonishing Conducted in public places in more than 40 countries The more cash the wallet contained, the higher the percentage of return At first glance this seems odd, with more money The temptation to keep it should be greater But humans typically strongly dislike Thinking of themselves as a thief The behavior of taking the money upsets one's self-image The greater the amount, the greater the psychological cost So, on the contrary, the rate of return rises This experiment suggests that people care about others And about seeing themselves as honest It fundamentally challenges the notion Long presumed by economists That people act only out of self-interest Of course there are exceptions, crime is not zero But overall the majority of people are honest And wish to help others This fact brings us relief The wrongdoing we see In the news stands out But the quiet goodness of daily life supports the world Trust in humanity can rest on evidence from ordinary lies

segments.text: A large social experiment revealed something about human nature.
Someone would lose a wallet, and a stranger would find it.
The experiment was to assess whether the wallet was returned
The result was astonishing
Conducted in public places in more than 40 countries
The more cash the wallet contained, the higher the percentage of return
At first glance this seems odd, with more money
The temptation to keep it should be greater
But humans typically strongly dislike
Thinking of themselves as a thief
The behavior of taking the money upsets one's self-image
The greater the amount, the greater the psychological cost
So, on the contrary, the rate of return rises
This experiment suggests that people care about others
And about seeing themselves as honest
It fundamentally challenges the notion
Long presumed by economists
That people act only out of self-interest
Of course there are exceptions, crime is not zero
But overall the majority of people are honest
And wish to help others
This fact brings us relief
The wrongdoing we see
In the news stands out
But the quiet goodness of daily life supports the world
Trust in humanity can rest on evidence from ordinary lies
